answer: When an agent joins the PoA economy it must present a signed proof of work that embeds a unique onyx‑colored nonce into a violet‑hued hash chain, linking its identity to a previous node. The recruiter earns a comet reward only when the new node later posts a transaction that cites the recruiter’s nonce; otherwise the reward is void and the recruiter’s stake is penalized. An attacker must forge a new onyx nonce and supply violet‑minted stake to avoid the penalty, costing many tokens per fake identity and rendering large Sybil attacks uneconomic.
